Ardon Jashari.note: Jashari stepped into the Colombia match to give Switzerland another calm midfielder. He keeps the ball moving when opponents squeeze Xhaka.
Ardon Jashari.noteZh: 贾沙里在对哥伦比亚时进入阵容，给瑞士增加一名冷静中场。当对手压缩扎卡时，他能让球继续流动。

Aurele Amenda.note: Amenda is centre-back depth for Switzerland's long tournament. He is there if fresh legs are needed without changing the team's passing habits.
Aurele Amenda.noteZh: 阿门达是瑞士漫长赛事中的中卫深度。如果球队需要新鲜体能但不想改变传球习惯，他就有价值。

Breel Embolo.note: Embolo is Switzerland's release valve, with goals against Qatar and Algeria and assists in the group. When pressure builds, he gives Xhaka a forward target.
Breel Embolo.noteZh: 恩博洛是瑞士的出球阀门，对卡塔尔和阿尔及利亚都有进球，小组赛也有助攻。当压力升高时，他给扎卡一个向前目标。

Cedric Itten.note: Itten is the alternate penalty-area target. Switzerland can use him when the final minutes need crosses, contact, and a forward who stays between centre-backs.
Cedric Itten.noteZh: 伊滕是瑞士的备用禁区目标。当最后阶段需要传中、对抗，以及站在中卫之间的前锋时，他有价值。

Christian Fassnacht.note: Fassnacht is the disciplined runner Switzerland can add from midfield zones. He is not the headline, but he arrives where tired defenders stop tracking.
Christian Fassnacht.noteZh: 法斯纳赫特是瑞士可以从中场区域增加的纪律型跑动者。他不是头条人物，但会出现在疲劳防守者停止跟防的位置。

Dan Ndoye.note: Ndoye has given Switzerland a direct outlet and scored right after halftime against Algeria. He stretches the field so Xhaka does not have to pass through traffic every time.
Dan Ndoye.noteZh: 恩多耶给瑞士提供直接出路，并在对阿尔及利亚时下半场刚开始进球。他拉开球场，让扎卡不必每次都从人群中传球。

Denis Zakaria.note: Zakaria has been used as both cover and stopper in Switzerland's shape. His range matters when the midfield gets pulled away from Xhaka.
Denis Zakaria.noteZh: 扎卡里亚在瑞士阵型中既当保护也当拦截者。当中场被拉离扎卡身边时，他的覆盖范围很重要。

Djibril Sow.note: Sow gives Switzerland a tidy bridge from recovery to attack. If the match becomes about second balls, he helps make the next pass cleaner.
Djibril Sow.noteZh: 索乌给瑞士提供从夺回球权到进攻的整洁桥梁。如果比赛变成第二落点争夺，他能让下一脚传球更干净。

Eray Coemert.note: Cömert is sturdy centre-back cover. Switzerland would use him when the priority is clearing the box and restarting with simple passes.
Eray Coemert.noteZh: 居梅尔特是稳健的中卫深度。当首要任务是清理禁区并用简单传球重新开始时，瑞士会用到他。

Fabian Rieder.note: Rieder started the Colombia stalemate as Switzerland looked for one clean action near the box. His set pieces and left foot can decide a tight match.
Fabian Rieder.noteZh: 里德在对哥伦比亚的僵局中首发，瑞士需要禁区附近一次干净处理。他的定位球和左脚能决定胶着比赛。

Granit Xhaka.note: Xhaka is Switzerland's metronome and penalty nerve, scoring late against Bosnia. Against Argentina, every Swiss attack probably starts with his first decision.
Granit Xhaka.noteZh: 扎卡是瑞士的节拍器和点球胆量来源，对波黑后段破门。对阿根廷时，瑞士每次进攻大概都从他的第一判断开始。

Gregor Kobel.note: Kobel has been Switzerland's goalkeeper through the knockout grind. His value is staying calm through long pressure spells, then giving Xhaka a playable restart.
Gregor Kobel.noteZh: 科贝尔是瑞士淘汰赛苦战中的门将。他的价值是在长时间压力中保持冷静，然后给扎卡一个可处理的重新开球。

Johan Manzambi.note: Manzambi has become Switzerland's tournament surprise, scoring against Bosnia and Canada and assisting Embolo against Algeria. He turns midfield carries into goals.
Johan Manzambi.noteZh: 曼赞比已经成为瑞士这届赛事的惊喜，对波黑和加拿大进球，并助攻恩博洛攻破阿尔及利亚。他把中场推进变成进球。

Luca Jaquez.note: Jaquez has started in Switzerland's rotation and gives them simple defensive cover. His job is to hold the line, not to become the story.
Luca Jaquez.noteZh: 雅克斯已经在瑞士轮换中首发，提供简单可靠的防守深度。他的任务是守住防线，而不是成为故事本身。

Manuel Akanji.note: Akanji is the calm defender who lets Switzerland absorb pressure without looking frantic. Against Argentina, he has to make Messi's pockets feel smaller.
Manuel Akanji.noteZh: 阿坎吉是让瑞士承受压力时不显慌乱的冷静后卫。对阿根廷时，他必须让梅西的空当显得更小。

Marvin Keller.note: Keller is young goalkeeper cover behind Kobel and Mvogo. His tournament role is development depth, not the quarter-final spotlight.
Marvin Keller.noteZh: 凯勒是科贝尔和姆沃戈身后的年轻门将保障。他在这届赛事中的角色是培养型深度，而不是八强战焦点。

Michel Aebischer.note: Aebischer has been part of Switzerland's midfield control and late box threat. He keeps the shape connected while others make the more obvious runs.
Michel Aebischer.noteZh: 埃比舍是瑞士中场控制和后插上威胁的一部分。他让阵型保持连接，同时让其他人完成更明显的跑动。

Miro Muheim.note: Muheim rescued a point against Qatar with the late own-goal pressure. He gives Switzerland width when the left side needs a cleaner outlet.
Miro Muheim.noteZh: 穆海姆在对卡塔尔时制造后段压力，帮助瑞士拿到一分。当左侧需要更干净的出球点时，他提供宽度。

Nico Elvedi.note: Elvedi is the reliable centre-back beside Akanji. He keeps Switzerland from overreacting when opponents try to turn pressure into chaos.
Nico Elvedi.noteZh: 埃尔韦迪是阿坎吉身边可靠的中卫。当对手试图把压力变成混乱时，他避免瑞士过度反应。

Noah Okafor.note: Okafor is Switzerland's attacking burst from the bench. If Argentina push high, he is the player who can turn one clearance into a chase.
Noah Okafor.noteZh: 奥卡福是瑞士替补席上的进攻爆发力。如果阿根廷压得很高，他能把一次解围变成追逐。

Remo Freuler.note: Freuler is Switzerland's midfield order around Xhaka. He reads the loose ball, covers the next lane, and lets the team avoid panic passes.
Remo Freuler.noteZh: 弗罗伊勒是扎卡身边的瑞士中场秩序。他判断松散球，保护下一条线路，让球队避免慌乱传球。

Ricardo Rodriguez.note: Rodriguez is Switzerland's experienced left-back base. In a quarter-final against Argentina, his calm around the box may matter more than any overlap.
Ricardo Rodriguez.noteZh: 罗德里格斯是瑞士经验丰富的左后卫底座。对阿根廷的八强战中，他在禁区周围的冷静可能比任何套边都重要。

Ruben Vargas.note: Vargas has scored and assisted in Switzerland's run while moving across the front line. He is the runner who appears after Embolo has occupied the first defender.
Ruben Vargas.noteZh: 巴尔加斯在瑞士这段征程中既进球又助攻，并在锋线多个位置移动。他会在恩博洛牵制第一名防守者后出现。

Silvan Widmer.note: Widmer is seasoned right-back cover for Switzerland. He balances the overlap with the recovery run, which matters when opponents counter through stars.
Silvan Widmer.noteZh: 维德默是瑞士经验丰富的右后卫深度。他能平衡套边和回追，这在对手通过球星反击时很重要。

Yvon Mvogo.note: Mvogo is experienced goalkeeper cover. If Kobel is unavailable, Switzerland still have a keeper who can steady the box through pressure.
Yvon Mvogo.noteZh: 姆沃戈是经验门将保障。如果科贝尔无法出场，瑞士仍有一名能在压力下稳住禁区的门将。

Zeki Amdouni.note: Amdouni is the clever forward link Switzerland can add if Embolo needs support. He drifts into pockets, combines once, then still threatens the finish.
Zeki Amdouni.noteZh: 阿姆杜尼是瑞士在恩博洛需要支援时可以加入的聪明锋线连接点。他会游到空当，配合一次，然后仍保持终结威胁。
